about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A45: themed one-pot pasta, fakeaway, lightened comfort classics and Mediterranean dinners.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Tomato and Basil Penne
recipes.summary: Penne cooks right in a garlicky tomato sauce, finished with cream and fresh basil.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil in a wide pot for 4 minutes, add the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, stock, salt and penne, bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce is thick.
Stir through the cream and basil and heat for 1 minute until glossy.
notes: Contains gluten and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken Alfredo Pasta
recipes.summary: Chicken, fettuccine and a creamy garlic sauce made in a single pot with no draining.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the stock, milk, fettuccine, salt and pepper, bring to a simmer and cook for 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the cream and parmesan for 2 minutes until silky and the chicken is cooked through.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: One-Pot Beef Bolognese Spaghetti
recipes.summary: Spaghetti simmers straight in a rich beef and tomato sauce, so there is only one pot to wash.
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 6 minutes until no pink remains, then add the onion, carrot and garlic for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes, paste, stock, oregano, salt and the spaghetti snapped in half, and bring to the boil until bubbling.
Simmer for 13 minutes, stirring often, until the spaghetti is tender and the sauce clings.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: One-Pot Sausage and Kale Orecchiette
recipes.summary: Sausage, kale and orecchiette in a garlicky tomato broth, all cooked together.
steps: Brown the sausage in the oil for 6 minutes, breaking it into chunks, then add the onion and garlic for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, stock, chilli and orecchiette and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is nearly tender.
Stir in the kale for 3 minutes until wilted and the pasta is cooked.
notes: Food safety: pork sausage must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: One-Pot Lemon Prawn Linguine
recipes.summary: Linguine cooked in garlicky lemon stock, topped with quick-seared prawns and parsley.
steps: Sear the prawns in half the oil for 2 minutes until pink, then set aside.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, add the stock, lemon juice, salt and linguine and simmer for 11 minutes, stirring, until tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Return the prawns with the zest and parsley and toss for 1 minute until hot.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: One-Pot Mushroom and Spinach Pasta
recipes.summary: Creamy-tasting vegan pasta with mushrooms, spinach and garlic cooked in one pot.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, then add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the stock, thyme, salt and penne and simmer for 11 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach for 2 minutes until the spinach has wilted.
notes: Contains gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice
recipes.summary: A mild, creamy tikka masala with yoghurt-marinated chicken, just like the takeaway.
steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, half the garam masala, turmeric and paprika and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and remaining garam masala for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Add the chicken and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through, then stir in the cream and salt.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender, drain and serve under the curry.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours, and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Sweet and Sour Chicken with Rice
recipes.summary: Crispy-coated chicken in a glossy sweet and sour sauce with capsicum and pineapple.
steps: Toss the chicken in the egg, then the cornflour. Fry in the oil in batches for 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Whisk the tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce together. Stir-fry the capsicum and onion for 3 minutes, add the sauce and pineapple and simmer for 3 minutes until glossy.
Return the chicken for 1 minute to coat. Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Sichuan Peanut Chicken with Rice
recipes.summary: Spicy, tangy chicken stir-fried with peanuts, capsicum and dried chilli, served over rice.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornflour. Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes until golden, add the capsicum, garlic, ginger and chilli for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and peanuts and toss for 2 minutes until the sauce is sticky and the chicken is cooked through. Scatter with spring onion and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains peanuts, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Lamb Doner Kebab Bowls
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb patty slices with salad, pickled onion and garlic yoghurt, no skewer needed.
steps: Knead the mince with the cumin, paprika, oregano, half the garlic and the salt until sticky, then press into a flat loaf about 2cm thick.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes a side until deeply browned and cooked to 75°C, then slice thinly.
Stir the remaining garlic and lemon juice into the yoghurt. Pile the lamb, tomato, cucumber and onion over warm flatbread and spoon on the sauce.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Naan Pizzas Margherita
recipes.summary: Crisp naan bases with tomato sauce, mozzarella and basil, ready from the oven in minutes.
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C (210°C fan) and mix the passata, garlic and oregano.
Spread the sauce over the naan, top with mozzarella and drizzle with oil. Bake on trays for 8 minutes until bubbling and golden at the edges.
Scatter with basil and serve.
notes: Contains gluten and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.summary: Crisp panko chicken with a mild, sweet Japanese-style curry sauce over rice.
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in a little oil for 6 minutes, stir in the garlic, curry powder and 1 tablespoon flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, soy sauce and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes until thick. Blend if you like it smooth.
Coat the chicken in flour, egg and panko. Shallow-fry in the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked to 75°C.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender. Slice the chicken and serve over rice with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Crispy Chilli Beef
recipes.summary: Crunchy strips of beef tossed in a sticky sweet chilli sauce with capsicum and spring onion.
steps: Toss the beef with the egg white and cornflour. Fry in batches in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp and browned, then drain.
Stir-fry the capsicum and garlic for 2 minutes, add the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce and vinegar and simmer for 1 minute until sticky.
Toss in the beef and spring onion for 30 seconds. Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender and serve.
notes: Food safety: beef strips should reach 71°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Tamarind Noodles with Prawns and Egg
recipes.summary: Rice noodles tossed with prawns, egg, bean sprouts and a tangy tamarind-style sauce.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until pliable, then drain. Stir the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice together.
Stir-fry the garlic and prawns in the oil for 2 minutes until pink, push aside and scramble the eggs for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 3 minutes until tender, then add the sprouts and spring onion for 1 minute. Top with peanuts.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque and eggs until set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains egg, peanuts, crustacean shellfish and fish.

recipes.title: Lightened Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
recipes.summary: Creamy baked mac and cheese with cauliflower blended into the sauce for less fat.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the macaroni for 8 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Simmer the cauliflower in the milk for 10 minutes until very soft. Blend with the flour, mustard and salt until smooth, then heat for 2 minutes until thickened and stir in the cheddar until melted.
Fold through the macaroni, tip into a dish, top with the hard cheese and breadcrumbs and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
notes: Contains gluten and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Lightened Grilled Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.summary: Chicken breast under tomato sauce and melted mozzarella, grilled rather than fried.
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, garlic, oregano and half the salt for 10 minutes until thick.
Rub the chicken with the oil and remaining salt. Grill or pan-fry for 5 minutes a side until golden.
Top with the sauce and cheeses and grill for 4 minutes until bubbling and the chicken is 75°C. Steam the beans for 5 minutes until tender and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Beef Stroganoff with Yoghurt
recipes.summary: All the creamy mushroom flavour of stroganoff using yoghurt in place of cream.
steps: Sear the beef in half the oil in batches for 2 minutes until browned, then set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the garlic, paprika and flour for 1 minute, then pour in the stock and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.
Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until tender. Off the heat stir the yoghurt and mustard into the sauce, return the beef and serve over the noodles.
notes: Food safety: beef strips should reach 71°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Mash
recipes.summary: Lamb and vegetable filling under a fluffy potato and cauliflower mash topping.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 6 minutes until no pink remains, add the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes, then the paste, stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 12 minutes until thick. Stir in the peas.
Boil the potato and cauliflower for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the milk and salt.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the filling into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 20 minutes until golden.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk. Worcestershire sauce contains fish and gluten.

recipes.title: Lightened Chicken Pot Pie with Filo Top
recipes.summary: Creamy chicken and vegetable filling under a crisp filo lid for far less pastry.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes, add the onion, carrot and leek for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the stock, milk and thyme and simmer for 12 minutes until thick and the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the peas.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Pour into a dish, scrunch the filo over the top, brush with butter and bake for 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Zucchini and Beef Lasagne
recipes.summary: A pasta-light lasagne layering zucchini ribbons, beef ragu and ricotta.
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 6 minutes until no pink remains, add the onion and garlic for 4 minutes, then the tomatoes, paste, oregano and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Mix the ricotta and egg. Layer the ragu, zucchini, lasagne sheets and ricotta in a dish, finishing with the mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover for 10 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Sweet Potato Topped Fish Pie
recipes.summary: Salmon and white fish in a light herby sauce under a golden sweet potato mash.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with half the salt.

Poach the fish in the milk with the bay leaf for 4 minutes, lift out and strain the milk. Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, whisk in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes until thick, then fold in the fish, peas, dill and zest.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, reaching 63°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked Cod with Tomatoes, Olives and Capers
recipes.summary: Cod baked on a bed of cherry tomatoes, olives and capers with lemon and oregano.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the potatoes with a third of the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers, garlic, oregano and remaining oil, nestle in the cod and top with lemon.
Bake for 15 minutes until the fish flakes easily and the tomatoes have burst.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, reaching 63°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Stew with Paprika and Lemon
recipes.summary: A fragrant tomato and chickpea stew with spinach, paprika and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, stock and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Stir in the spinach and lemon juice for 2 minutes until wilted.
notes: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 4 days.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Salmon with Herby Couscous
recipes.summary: Roasted salmon with lemon on couscous loaded with parsley, cucumber and tomato.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the salmon with half the oil, lemon zest, garlic and half the salt and roast for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous with the remaining salt, cover for 5 minutes until fluffy, then fork through the remaining oil and lemon juice.
Fold in the cucumber, tomato and parsley and top with the salmon.
notes: Food safety: salmon should reach 63°C and flake easily; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish and gluten.
